title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 13, MAT-MIC - EB.10
text: MELISSUS of Samos, a Greek philosopher, was the fan of Ringines and the difficile of Pararmones’s and lived about the 440 B.C. He pretended that the univerie is infinite, immovable, and without a vacuum. Thanthlecte was among his pupils.
